name: GitHub
description: The Sumo Logic App for GitHub connects to your GitHub repository at the Organization or Repository level, and ingests GitHub events via a webhook. These events populate the pre-configured Dashboards to give you a complete overview of your GitHub's branches, issues, pull requests, user activity, and security events.

panels.name: Files Added per Branch
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Github added "commits" repository pusher 
| json "ref", "commits[*].added[*]", "repository.name", "pusher.name" as branch, files, repo_name, user
| where files != "[]"
| parse regex field=branch "^\S+\/\S+\/(?<branch_name>\S+)$"
| concat(repo_name,"/" ,branch_name) as Bname
| replace(files, ",","") as Cfiles
| (length(files) - length (Cfiles) +1) as num_files 
| timeslice 1d
|sum(num_files) group by Bname, _timeslice
| order by _sum
| transpose row _timeslice column Bname

panels.name: Commits per Branch
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Github "commits" "id" "distinct" repository pusher 
| json "ref", "commits[*].id[*]", "repository.name", "pusher.name" as branch, commit_size, repo_name, user
| where commit_size != "[]"
| parse regex field=branch "^\S+\/\S+\/(?<branch_name>\S+)$"
| concat(repo_name,"/" ,branch_name) as Bname
| replace(commit_size, ",","") as Ccommit_size
| (length(commit_size) - length(Ccommit_size) + 1) as num_commits 
| timeslice 1d
|sum(num_commits) group by Bname, _timeslice
| order by _sum
| transpose row _timeslice column Bname

panels.name: Files Deleted per Branch

| where files_del != "[]"
| parse regex field=branch "^\S+\/\S+\/(?<branch_name>\S+)$"
| concat(repo_name,"/" ,branch_name) as Bname
| replace(files_del, ",","") as Cfiles_del
| (length(Cfiles_del) - length (Cfiles_del) +1) as num_del_files
| timeslice 1d
|sum(num_del_files) group by Bname, _timeslice
| order by _sum
| transpose row _timeslice column Bname

panels.name: Files Added per Branch
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Github
| json "ref", "commits[*].added[*]", "repository.name", "pusher.name" as branch, files, repo_name, user
| where files != "[]"
| parse regex field=branch "^\S+\/\S+\/(?<branch_name>\S+)$"
| concat(repo_name,"/" ,branch_name) as Bname
| replace(files, ",","") as Cfiles
| (length(files) - length (Cfiles) +1) as num_files 
|sum(num_files) group by Bname, user
| order by _sum
| transpose row user column Bname
